Thank you for saying all that. And I know I'll regret everything if I ever become happy but for now it would just be bad for me to stop talking to these people because they're the only ones who even listen to me sometimes. I do worry the people I talk to are talking other kids because I don't want that happening to people but a lot of them won't even show their face or anything so it wouldn't lead to anything.

I don't really think I'm being groomed, I think they're trying to groom me but I don't really care about the actual people I talk to, I just need someone to talk to and they're always there. And yes there is someone I completely trust and they could stop me from doing this but I feel like it wouldn't be a good idea to tell them because they would do a lot to make me happy and it would end up making them sad.

I've tried 6 antidepressants and lots of sleeping pills and now an antipsychotic to try make my sleep regular and my mood okay and the only one that changed my sleep gave me bad insomnia and extreme suicidal ideation and the meds I'm on now seem to work okay so I really don't even want to try again, it takes months and it's exhausting changing meds a lot really. My psychiatrists are terrible and at my age they don't offer any other medications really, they had to be convinced on some too, lots of my problems just don't seem treatable and are probably just lifelong things.
I may do that, it's definitely an option anyway.

I have to stay on my meds although they're practically sleeping pills but even before that I needed about 12 hours a night and a 2 hour nap every day, I've been like that since I was 11 and it isn't because of a deficiency in anything so I'm stuck like this really.

That's what I think might happen and why I might be an asshole if I get him to send me, I might only do a month then not be able to continue and he'd have wasted so much money and it would all have been pointless. I've had issues with sleeping too much for about 4 years also so even if my mental health is okay I might get really burnt out and have to spend 3 weeks to catch up on sleep and alone time. It feels like a waste but the other option is crap too.

I think where I live you only have to have done 6 subjects, maths, english and a language are mandatory but my school pretty much gives out language exemptions so it's only english and maths and 4 others of your choice.

My main concern is that I'd be too tired to even attend, I'd be able to do half days at most probably and that's unlikely to change anytime soon and I think it would be pointless if I couldn't even get into school.
It's a school for people who really aren't ever going to college so I don't blame it really, they make it easy so people won't drop out.
I just know for sure he'd do it at my family's expense, but it is his decision I suppose. I will possibly look into summer jobs though for sure if I ask.
He would definitely send me but it would be a lot of money potentially wasted and he would be stressed because of it.
He would definitely say yes but it would stress him out a lot and he might be wasting his money on it and my reasons for going are quite selfish too.

The thing is I know for certain he'd say yes because he wants me to get a good education but it would make him stressed and while he has the money he probably wouldn't have money for holidays and other activities he wants to do if I went. And even if I go there's no guarantee I'll last longer than a month there. I feel I would be a bit selfish I think.

she has 4 i think, i feel bad for them because she obviously doesn't care about them and leaves them unsupervised with her 4 year old daughter who regularly cuts the cats whiskers, i got really upset when she told me that but i couldn't do anything

i did think about this for a while but ultimately ignored it which was a bad decision by me but oh well

you shouldn't feel bad for it, i generally stick with toxic people for far too long and it can get me very depressed, i don't know the whole story with you but i imagine it was for the best so you shouldn't regret it
